{{DISPLAYTITLE:Plot in ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''}}
''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]'', receiving an almost unanimous critical acclaim, has a long, complex but still comprehensible '''plot or storyline'''.

==Brief==
Five years ago, [[Carl Johnson]] escaped from the pressures of life in [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]], [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|San Andreas]]: a city tearing itself apart with gang trouble, drugs, and corruption, where film stars and millionaires do their best to avoid the dealers and gangbangers.

Now, it's the early 90s. Carl's got to go home. His mother has been murdered, his family has fallen apart, and his childhood friends are all heading towards disaster.

On his return to the neighborhood, a couple of corrupt cops frame him for homicide. CJ is forced on a journey that takes him across the entire state of San Andreas, to save his family and to take control of the streets.

== Storyline ==

===Prior Events===
[[Carl Johnson]] ("CJ") was born and raised in [[Grove Street (3D Universe)|Grove Street]], [[Ganton]], [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]], sharing a [[The Johnson House|house]] with his mother [[Beverly Johnson|Beverly]], brothers [[Sweet|Sean]] ("Sweet") and [[Brian Johnson|Brian]], and sister [[Kendl]]. Sweet, CJ, and their friends, [[Big Smoke|Melvin Harris]] ("Big Smoke") and [[Ryder|Lance Wilson]] ("Ryder"), joined the [[Grove Street Families]] gang as children. Sweet worked his way up the ranks to become the gang's leader, while Carl became the underboss and Big Smoke and Ryder became high-ranking lieutenants. The Grove Street Families gained power in Los Santos, fighting with the [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]] and [[Los Santos Vagos (3D Universe)|Vagos]] for control of the streets.

In [[1987]], Brian Johnson died. The cause of his death was never revealed, though it was implied that Carl had been present and did not attempt to help him. Sweet held Carl responsible for Brian's death, which led to Carl leaving Los Santos and moving to [[Liberty City (3D Universe)|Liberty City]], where he started working as a car thief for [[Joey Leone]]. The Grove Street Families began losing power and turf as the Ballas and Vagos became involved in the highly lucrative Los Santos drug trade. GSF maintained control of their remaining territories by splitting up into three factions: the original Grove Street Families (ruling Ganton), the Seville Boulevard Families (having control of [[Playa del Seville]]), and the Temple Drive Families (mainly establishing themselves in [[Temple]] and [[Santa Maria Beach]]).

In [[1992]], the Ballas planned to assassinate Sweet to deprive the Families of their leader and take over their territory. They used a green [[The Green Sabre (car)|Sabre]] to perform a [[Drive-By Shooting|drive-by shooting]] on the Johnson house. However, instead of Sweet, the Ballas killed Beverly. Sweet phoned Carl to inform him of their mother's death, and Carl agreed to return to Los Santos for the funeral.

===The Return of CJ===
Carl arrives at the airport and takes a taxi to his mother's house. However, he is arrested enroute by [[Frank Tenpenny]], [[Eddie Pulaski]], and [[Jimmy Hernandez]], police officers from a corrupt [[Los Santos Police Department (3D Universe)|LSPD]] unit called [[C.R.A.S.H.]] They steal his belongings and threaten to frame him for the [[The Introduction|murder]] of another officer, [[Ralph Pendelbury]], unless he works for them whenever they summon him. After C.R.A.S.H. let him go, warning Carl that they will be watching him, he makes his way to his mother's house, where he reunites with Big Smoke. After he promises CJ that they will learn who killed his mother, the pair drive to the funeral, where Carl reunites with Sweet, Kendl and Ryder. Sweet is displeased with Carl's return, claiming that Carl ran away. Kendl becomes annoyed with Sweet and walks off. Suddenly, the Ballas attempt a drive-by, destroying Smoke's car. After escaping the funeral, CJ, Sweet, Smoke, and Ryder race back to Grove Street. Seeing the state of the gang, Carl decides to stay and help get it back on its feet.

Carl begins working with Sweet, Smoke, and Ryder to restore their gang's influence. At first, he does small jobs, such as [[Tagging Up Turf|spraying enemy gang tags]], [[Cleaning the Hood|clearing the hood of crack dealers]], [[Nines and AK's|buying weapons]] from [[Emmet]], and [[Drive-By|performing drive-bys]] in Ballas territories. Eventually, he moves on to bigger operations, such as stealing weapons for fellow gang members [[Home Invasion|from]] [[Catalyst|various]] [[Robbing Uncle Sam|sources]] across Los Santos with Ryder and accompanying Big Smoke [[Running Dog|on]] [[Wrong Side of the Tracks|several]] [[Just Business|deals]]. During this time, CJ also reunites with another friend and occasional gang member [[OG Loc (3D Universe)|OG Loc]], who was just released from prison. Loc asks for CJ's help in [[OG Loc (mission)|killing]] his [[Freddy (GTA San Andreas)|former cellmate]]. Afterwards, he helps Loc make a name for himself in the rapping industry by [[Life's a Beach|stealing some equipment from a beach party]], as well as the [[Madd Dogg's Rhymes|rhyme book]] of famous rapper [[Madd Dogg (3D Universe)|Madd Dogg]], and [[Management Issues|killing]] Dogg's [[Alan Crawford|manager]]. While attending a [[House Party|house party]] hosted by OG Loc, several Ballas attack Grove Street, but CJ and Sweet are able to fend them off.

Later, Sweet asks CJ to [[Cesar Vialpando (mission)|spy]] on Kendl's new boyfriend [[Cesar Vialpando]], who is the leader of the Hispanic gang [[Varrios Los Aztecas (3D Universe)|Varrios Los Aztecas]], which displeases him. Despite his initial prejudices, Carl discovers that Cesar is a good man and genuinely cares about Kendl. CJ competes in [[High Stakes, Low-Rider|a car race]] against Cesar, after which the two men become good friends. C.R.A.S.H. also call on CJ and force him to help them with their shady operations, such as [[Burning Desire|burning down a house occupied by the Vagos]] and [[Gray Imports|interrupting a meeting]] between the Ballas and the [[Russian Mafia (3D Universe)|Russian Mafia]].

Eventually, CJ successfully [[Doberman|takes over]] the Ballas territory of [[Glen Park]] and kills a former Grove Street member who joined the Ballas named [[Little Weasel]]. Shortly after, Sweet informs Carl that several high-ranking Ballas will be attending Weasel's funeral, including [[Kane]], and the brothers use this opportunity to [[Los Sepulcros|kill them]], weakening their enemy. After CJ [[Gang Warfare in GTA San Andreas|takes over more turf for Grove Street]], Sweet decides to attempt to [[Reuniting the Families|reunite the three sets of the Families]] with CJ, Big Smoke, and Ryder's help. However, the meeting is ambushed by the police, and the group barely manage to escape after a long chase.

With the Ballas severely weakened, Sweet decides it is time for Grove Street to regain control of Los Santos and plans to [[The Green Sabre|ambush]] a major group of Ballas under the [[Mulholland Intersection]] to end the gang war. Before he can join his brother in the attack, CJ is called by Cesar, who asks to meet him in [[Verdant Bluffs]]. There, Cesar reveals that he had been investigating the drive-by shooting that killed Beverly and learned it was meant for Sweet. Just then, the pair spot Big Smoke, Ryder, the C.R.A.S.H. officers, and some Ballas exiting a garage containing a green [[Sabre]], the same car used in the drive-by.

Carl realizes that Big Smoke and Ryder have sold out Grove Street to the Ballas and have been working with C.R.A.S.H., and they organized the drive-by in an attempt to kill Sweet and wipe out the gang. This also means that Sweet must be headed into a trap. CJ goes to save him, only to find him severely injured. Sweet orders Carl to leave, but he refuses and kills several waves of Ballas. However, the police arrive and arrest the brothers. Sweet is taken to a prison hospital while C.R.A.S.H. drives Carl outside of Los Santos, to the small town of [[Angel Pine]] in rural [[Whetstone]].

===Whetstone, Flint County, & Red County===
C.R.A.S.H. warns Carl not to return to Los Santos to kill Big Smoke; if he does, Sweet will suffer in prison. They continue blackmailing CJ into working for them and task him with [[Badlands|killing an informant]] under [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] protection who is threatening to reveal their corruption to the authorities. After the job is done, Carl decides to start making money, in part to cover Sweet's bail. He calls Cesar, who advises him to meet with his cousin [[Catalina|Catalina.]] CJ [[First Date (GTA San Andreas)|meets]] Catalina and the pair perform [[Tanker Commander|various]] [[Local Liquor Store|small]][[Against All Odds|-time]] [[Small Town Bank|robberies]] together, during which they enter a short-lived relationship.

Carl is soon summoned by Tenpenny for another job and is introduced to a hippie named [[The Truth]], Tenpenny's [[Weed|marijuana]] supplier. Tenpenny asks CJ to assist The Truth in producing a large quantity of drugs which he will be needing in the near future. The Truth requests that Carl [[Body Harvest|steal]] a [[Combine Harvester|combine harvester]] from a farm and deliver it to him, promising to call Carl when the weed Tenpenny requires is ready. Shortly after, Carl calls Cesar and insists that he leaves Los Santos with Kendl, as the Grove Street Families and Varrios Los Aztecas are both disbanded, and their territories have been taken over by the Ballas and Vagos. CJ [[King in Exile|meets]] with Cesar and Kendl and rents them a trailer home in Angel Pine until he finds a better place for them to stay.

Later, Carl begins competing in car races to earn money and meets [[Wu Zi Mu]] ("Woozie"), the blind leader of the [[Mountain Cloud Boys]] subsection of the [[San Fierro Triads]], during [[Wu Zi Mu (mission)|one of the races]]. Carl also competes in [[Farewell, My Love...|a race]] against Catalina's new boyfriend [[Claude]], winning the deed to a [[Doherty Garage|garage]] in [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|Doherty, San Fierro]]. After parting ways with Catalina, who [[Grand Theft Auto III|leaves]] for Liberty City with Claude, CJ [[Are You Going to San Fierro?|returns]] to The Truth, who informs him that the marijuana supply for Tenpenny is ready. However, the police find out about the weed farm after being tipped off by Tenpenny, forcing CJ and The Truth to torch the marijuana fields and destroy a [[Police Maverick (3D Universe)|police helicopter]] with a [[Rocket Launcher (3D Universe)|rocket launcher]], before driving to Carl's garage in San Fierro with the drugs.

===San Fierro===
Carl meets Cesar and Kendl at the garage and finds out that it is derelict. He gets angry, but his sister calms him down and tells him that they can make it into a successful chop shop. Carl [[Wear Flowers in Your Hair|recruits]] some of The Truth's acquaintances—mechanics [[Dwaine]] and [[Jethro]], and electronics expert [[Zero]]—to help him get the garage working. Shortly after, Tenpenny calls Carl to tell him it's time to use the marijuana acquired from The Truth. Carl must plant it in the trunk of a [[Merit|car]] belonging to a [[District Attorney|district attorney]] who has been investigating Tenpenny and Pulaski. The job results in the attorney's arrest. Later, the C.R.A.S.H. officers pay Carl a surprise visit, this time [[Snail Trail|demanding]] that he follows a [[The Reporter|reporter]] who has been investigating them back to Los Santos, where he kills both the reporter and a [[The Journalist|journalist]] he is meeting with.

During his time in San Fierro, CJ purchases Zero's RC shop and [[Air Raid|helps him]] [[Supply Lines...|win]] [[New Model Army|an RC model war]] against his rival [[Berkley]]. He further earns the trust and respect of Woozie and the Triads after [[Mountain Cloud Boys (mission)|helping]] [[Ran Fa Li (mission)|them]] [[Lure (GTA San Andreas)|win]] [[Amphibious Assault|a gang]] [[The Da Nang Thang|war]] against a Vietnamese gang called the [[Da Nang Boys]]. One day, Cesar calls CJ to inform him of a Ballas car seen leaving the Mulholland Intersection and heading towards the countryside. They follow it to Angel Pine, where they take photos of a meeting between Ryder and some other men. CJ and Cesar soon learn that the men, [[Jizzy B]], [[T-Bone Mendez]], and [[Mike Toreno]], are the leaders of the [[Loco Syndicate]], an organization supplying [[Cocaine|crack cocaine]] to Big Smoke, Ryder, and the Ballas. Deciding to eliminate the organization, Carl first infiltrates it by [[Jizzy (mission)|offering his services to Jizzy]]. After [[T-Bone Mendez (mission)|several]] [[Mike Toreno (mission)|missions]] [[Outrider|for the organization]], CJ eventually earns their trust before [[Ice Cold Killa|turning on them and killing Jizzy]]. From Jizzy's phone, CJ then learns about the Syndicate's next meeting with the Ballas, which he [[Pier 69 (mission)|ambushes with the help of Cesar and the Triads, killing both T-Bone and Ryder]]. Carl later [[Toreno's Last Flight|destroys]] Toreno's helicopter, seemingly killing him, [[Yay Ka-Boom-Boom|as well as]] the Syndicate's [[Loco Syndicate Crack Factory|drug factory]], putting them out of business.

With the Loco Syndicate eliminated, CJ focuses on earning money through his garage business. He buys the [[Wang Cars (GTA San Andreas)|Wang Cars]] dealership and [[Driving School|attends the driving school to learn some advanced driving techniques]] that later help him and Cesar [[Zeroing In|steal]] [[Test Drive|various]] [[Customs Fast Track|cars]] [[Puncture Wounds|for the dealership]].

===Tierra Robada and Bone County===
Some time later, CJ receives a phone call from a man using a digitally distorted voice, demanding that he come to a [[Mike Toreno's Ranch|ranch]] in [[Tierra Robada]]. There, Carl is surprised to find Toreno still alive, who reveals himself as the caller. Toreno explains to CJ that Sweet is in an upstate prison, but is safe, and that officer Ralph Pendelbury (whose murder C.R.A.S.H. threatened to frame Carl for) was killed under Tenpenny's orders because Pendelbury wanted to report him to [[Internal Affairs Division|Internal Affairs]]. Toreno knows all this because he is an undercover government agent. In exchange for Sweet's freedom, he demands that CJ assist with his shady operations. With no other choice, Carl agrees and performs [[Highjack|several]] [[Interdiction|jobs]] for Toreno. Afterwards, he is asked to [[Verdant Meadows (mission)|buy]] an [[Verdant Meadows Airfield|abandoned airfield]] in the desert and [[Learning to Fly|learn to fly planes and helicopters]], which helps him with his [[N.O.E.|next set]] [[Stowaway|of missions]] for Toreno.

While at the airstrip, CJ is visited by The Truth, who asks for his help in [[Black Project|stealing]] a $60 million [[Jetpack]] from [[Area 69 (3D Universe)|Area 69]]. Carl then uses the jetpack to also [[Green Goo|steal]] a [[Green Goo (artifact)|mysterious green substance]] from a [[Freight|military train]] and deliver it to The Truth, who lets him keep the jetpack before parting ways.

===Las Venturas===
CJ receives a call from Woozie—who has become a successful businessman by opening a [[The Four Dragons Casino|casino]] in [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]]—telling Carl to come visit him. CJ moves to Las Venturas and discovers that the casino business is not doing as well as intended due to opposition from the [[Leone Crime Family|Leone]], [[Sindacco Crime Family|Sindacco]], and [[Forelli Crime Family|Forelli]] [[Mafia]] families of Liberty City. Carl agrees to assist and defends Woozie and the casino from rival mob families. He [[Fender Ketchup|scares]] their [[Johnny Sindacco|underboss]] into revealing which family he is working for and [[You've Had Your Chips|destroys]] a Sindacco-controlled plastics factory producing fake chips meant to be smuggled into Woozie's casino. As revenge, Carl helps Woozie plan a robbery of the rival [[Caligula's Casino]], which is run by the mob. He performs numerous jobs in preparation for the heist, such as [[Explosive Situation|stealing some dynamite]],[[Architectural Espionage| photographing the plans of the casino]], [[Key to Her Heart|stealing a swipe card]] for the casino from a [[Millie Perkins|croupier]], [[Dam and Blast|setting explosives at the city dam]] to cut off the casino's electricity, [[Cop Wheels|stealing some HPV1000 police bikes]] for the getaway, and [[Up, Up and Away!|highjacking an armored van]] using a [[Leviathan]] helicopter and respraying it with the Caligula's Casino logo.

Later, Carl receives a call from The Truth, who reveals that the previous night he travelled into the desert with a British band called [[The Gurning Chimps (3D Universe)|The Gurning Chimps]], but after smoking some peyote, they all fell unconscious. The Truth is in Los Santos with almost no memories of the night before or how he got there. He then asks CJ to [[Don Peyote|save]] the band's manager [[Kent Paul]] and lead singer [[Maccer]] from the desert, which he does. Carl brings them to Caligula's Casino, managed by Paul's old friend [[Ken Rosenberg]]. Seeing this as another opportunity to infiltrate, CJ begins [[Intensive Care|working with Ken]] [[The Meat Business|in order to earn the mob's trust]] and learns that Ken has been chosen by each Mafia family as a neutral party to run the casino on their behalf. His responsibility is to keep the peace, and if a war takes place between the families on his turf, Ken will pay with his life.

In time, a conflict between the Sindacco and Leone families escalates into a war between all three families, prompting the Leone family's Don, [[Salvatore Leone]], to travel to Las Venturas and take over Caligula's. CJ offers his services to Salvatore, who accepts. He first sends Carl to [[Freefall|kill several hitmen arriving in the city by plane]], and later to [[Saint Mark's Bistro|assassinate]] the Forelli boss, [[Marco Forelli]], in Liberty City. During the second mission, CJ also helps Ken, Paul, and Maccer escape from the mob by faking their deaths and telling them to flee Las Venturas.

Having earned Salvatore's trust, CJ decides it is time to rob Caligula's. Aided by Woozie, Zero, and the Triads, [[Breaking the Bank at Caligula's|the heist is carried out successfully]], weakening the mob and allowing the Triads to freely run their casino. Woozie [[Fish in a Barrel|asks]] Carl to become his business partner and he accepts. The pair run the casino together. CJ receives a threatening call from Salvatore but ignores him, cutting his ties with the mob.

During his time in Las Venturas, CJ also meets the rapper Madd Dogg and [[Madd Dogg (mission)|saves him from a suicide attempt]]; Carl unwittingly destroyed his career while helping OG Loc, which caused Dogg to fall into depression. Carl is later summoned by Tenpenny and Pulaski for one final job: to [[Misappropriation|kill]] a [[Drug Enforcement Administration|DEA]] [[The Dossier Carrier|agent]] and collect the dossier he's carrying. With the task complete, Tenpenny asks CJ to meet him in [[Las Brujas|an abandoned village]] in the desert to hand it over. Once there, however, CJ is [[High Noon|betrayed]] by Tenpenny and Pulaski. Tenpenny also turns on Hernandez after discovering that he had snitched on his corrupt partners, reporting them to Internal Affairs. Tenpenny knocks Hernandez unconscious with a shovel before leaving the scene. Pulaski forces Carl to dig his own grave and one for Hernandez. Once that's done, Pulaski prepares to shoot CJ, but Hernandez regains consciousness and saves him, taking a fatal bullet from Pulaski in the process. Carl then pursues and kills Pulaski.

With Woozie's casino a success, Carl finds the task of running it boring, as both he and Kendl wish to return to Los Santos. CJ is surprised when Madd Dogg, having returned from rehab, visits him and asks him to become his manager and restore his career. Carl agrees and returns to Los Santos with Kendl and Cesar, where he [[A Home in the Hills|reclaims]] [[Madd Dogg's Crib|Dogg's mansion]] from the Vagos, to whom he sold it for drugs, with the help of the Triads. He then calls Ken Rosenberg, Kent Paul, and Maccer, who fled Las Venturas for Los Santos, and recruits them to work for Madd Dogg and help him restore his career.

===Return to Los Santos===
CJ receives a surprise visit from Toreno, who presses him for one last favor: to [[Vertical Bird|steal]] [[Hydra|a military jet]] from the [[LHD-069]] amphibious assault ship anchored at the [[Easter Basin Naval Base]] and use it to destroy a flotilla of [[Tropic|spy ships]]. Carl does so, and Toreno keeps his promise by having Sweet released early. Carl [[Home Coming|goes to pick up his brother]] and tries to impress him with all the businesses he has acquired since he left Los Santos: the garage in San Fierro, the casino in Las Venturas, and the management of Madd Dogg. However, Sweet is unhappy, believing that Carl has neglected the gang in the process. To prove his loyalty, Carl takes his brother back to Ganton and they work together to reclaim Grove Street from the Ballas, re-establishing the Grove Street Families. 

The Johnson brothers then begin to reclaim their gang's turf from their rivals and attempt to track down Big Smoke. Learning that former gang member [[B Dup]] is working for him, CJ and Sweet go [[Beat Down on B Dup|to confront him in the hopes of finding out Smoke's whereabouts]], but to no avail. Instead, they convince [[Big Bear]], one of the Families' oldest members, to quit drugs and rejoin the gang. Later, CJ also helps Sweet [[Grove 4 Life|take over]] [[Idlewood]] from the Ballas, and aids Madd Dogg's [[Cut Throat Business|revenge on OG Loc]], who goes bankrupt while Dogg officially restarts his rapping career.

Meanwhile, Tenpenny is arrested and put on trial for several charges but is acquitted due to lack of evidence; all of the prosecution's witnesses have either been killed by CJ or otherwise gone missing. This angers the people of Los Santos, leading to a [[Riot (GTA San Andreas)|citywide riot]]. During this time, Carl helps Cesar [[Los Desperados|reclaim his gang's turf]] from the Vagos and continues claiming more territories from the Ballas and Vagos, until the Grove Street Families become powerful enough for Sweet to locate Big Smoke.

The Johnson brothers [[End of the Line|head]] to [[Big Smoke's Crack Palace|Smoke's crack palace]] to kill him for his betrayal of the gang, but CJ apologizes to Sweet and convinces to let him deal with Smoke on his own, to make up for all his mistakes. Fighting his way through the fortress, Carl eventually confronts Big Smoke and attempts to reason with him, but a cold, apathetic Smoke opens fire on CJ. In the ensuing firefight, Carl fatally shoots Smoke, who admits that he got caught up in the money and the power. His last words are, "Everybody will remember my name! Big Smoke!" 

As Carl laments Smoke's death, claiming it was a "waste", Tenpenny arrives to collect his share of Smoke's money from the drug trade. He holds Carl at gunpoint and orders him to load the money into his briefcase, intending to use it to flee the city. He then attempts to kill Carl but fails. With Los Santos turned against him, Tenpenny flees in a stolen [[Firetruck (3D Universe)|fire truck]], but Sweet grabs hold of the truck's ladder. Carl follows them in a [[Feltzer|car]] and manages to catch Sweet just as he loses his grip. The brothers then chase Tenpenny together, with Sweet taking the wheel while Carl shoots at intervening police officers and rioting gang members. Unable to shake his pursuers, Tenpenny loses control of the fire truck and veers off the bridge over Grove Street, suffering severe injuries. After claiming that he "cleaned up the streets", Tenpenny finally dies as CJ, his friends, and his family watch. The Truth congratulates Carl on "beating the system" before they head into the Johnson house to celebrate. 

Carl, Sweet, Kendl, and Cesar are next seen discussing what their future holds when Madd Dogg, Ken Rosenberg, Kent Paul, and Maccer arrive. Dogg proudly shows off his first gold record. As his friends and family congratulate the rapper, CJ heads outside, claiming he's "fittin' to hit the block, see what's happening''.''" With Tenpenny dead, the riots come to an end, and peace is finally restored in Los Santos.
